meta.title: APR vs APY — 5 DeFi terms explained in 60 seconds
meta.description:
APR or APY? TVL or market cap? Five DeFi terms that trip up almost everyone, explained in plain English in under a minute.

0:00 APR vs APY
0:12 TVL vs Market Cap
0:24 Staking vs Lending
0:36 Gas vs Fee
0:48 CEX vs DEX

Educational only — not financial advice. Do your own research.

lines.text: APR is the plain rate, no compounding
APY adds compounding on top of it
the same pool can quote you both
TVL is what people deposited into it
market cap is what its token is worth
big TVL with a small cap gets attention
lending hands tokens to a borrower
one pays for security, one pays for risk
gas is what the network charges you
a fee is what the app charges you
cheap chains only fix the first one
a CEX holds the keys on your behalf
a DEX lets you keep them yourself
not your keys, not your coins
